recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key studio portrait of a female figure in a dynamic, arched pose against a seamless white background. The subject is dressed in minimalist white attire, holding a microphone with a long, tangled black cord that creates a vertical graphic line. The composition is balanced by sharp, angular custom lettering in the upper left and thin, spaced sans-serif type in the lower right.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical tension between the microphone cord and the subject's arched body
Contrast between the stark white environment and the dark, tangled cable
Diagonal balance between the large script in the top-left and the small block text in the bottom-right
coreInvariants: High-key lighting with soft, diffused shadows
A single, continuous black line (microphone cord) acting as a graphic element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central full-body figure, scaled to occupy approximately 70% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The microphone held high above the head, serving as the origin point for the vertical cord.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left script, follows the subject's arched back down to the tangled cord at the feet, and ends at the bottom-right text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space surrounding the subject to emphasize the silhouette.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely high value with low saturation; skin tones are natural but brightened.

letterConstructionRules: Top-left: Sharp, aggressive angles with varying stroke widths, mimicking a signature.
Bottom-right: Ultra-light weight, wide tracking, and geometric proportions.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script 'K' features a long, sharp descending stroke.
The 'E' in the bottom text has perfectly horizontal, equal-length bars.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between expressive, heavy script and rigid, light geometric sans.
graphicDevices: Tangled cord at the base to ground the composition

preserve: Hairline weight of the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sharp, signature-like quality of the primary mark.
Provides the necessary geometric, clean look for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio photograph of a woman in a white sleeveless top and white heels, in a deep back-bend pose against a white wall. She holds a vintage microphone high; a black cord runs straight down to a messy pile on the floor.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, sharp, angular grey script logo in the top-left corner tilted slightly. Add a small, light-grey, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif title in all-caps in the bottom-right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white with minimal shadows?
Is the microphone cord a distinct black line?
Is the secondary text hairline thin and widely spaced?
Is the primary script sharp and angular?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the bottom-right text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the cord does not obscure the subject's face.
Check that the white clothing doesn't disappear into the white background.
Verify the text is legible despite the light grey color.
Confirm the composition feels balanced diagonally.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key, monochromatic fashion portrait with a vertical graphic line (cord/wire) and high-contrast typographic pairing (aggressive script vs. minimalist sans).
